jobs.occupation: Lead Developer
jobs.description:
Are you ready to take technical ownership of a business-critical application landscape and drive the modernization of software platforms in Orifarm - an international pharmaceutical company with high ambitions and a digital transformation agenda?

About the job

As Lead Developer, you will take technical ownership of Orifarm’s business-critical application landscape and help drive the modernization of our software platforms.

You will work in an environment consisting of custom-developed .NET applications, SQL Server databases, integrations, and web-based solutions. The landscape contains a mix of legacy and modern technologies, and an important part of the role will be balancing day-to-day delivery with long-term improvements.

You will provide technical leadership within the development team, drive modernization, helping to shape solution designs, ensuring code quality, and driving continuous improvement across applications and development practices while remaining hands-on with coding yourself.

Responsibilities

• Provide technical leadership and guidance to the development team, contribute to architectural discussions, review code, and promote development best practices

• Ensure high standards for maintainability, performance, security, and quality, and support developers in solving complex technical challenges

• Design, develop, and maintain business-critical applications, participating actively in hands-on development

• Analyze existing applications and identify opportunities for improvement and modernization, contributing to the evolution of legacy systems while supporting the introduction of new technologies

• Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into scalable solutions

• Work closely with development team to ensure alignment between architecture and implementation

• Participate in planning, estimation, and prioritization activities, and support deployments, releases, and operational improvements

Who Are You?

You are an experienced developer who combines deep C# and SQL Server expertise with strong leadership capabilities. You are comfortable investigating a complex stored procedure, reviewing application architecture, mentoring developers, and making pragmatic technical decisions that keep the business moving forward.

You understand modern development practices and web technologies, but you also appreciate the realities of maintaining and evolving business-critical systems that have been developed over many years. You enjoy solving complex technical problems, you lead by example, you take ownership of technical quality and delivery, and you are motivated by improving systems, processes, and ways of working.

Key Qualifications:

• 7+ years of experience as a Senior Developer, Lead Developer, Technical Lead, or similar role, including experience leading development teams or acting as a technical mentor

• Experience working with enterprise applications and complex business systems, and a strong understanding of software architecture and design patterns

• Experience working with both legacy systems and modernization initiatives

• Strong hands-on experience with C# / .NET, ASP.NET, web application development, Microsoft SQL Server, database design and optimization, REST APIs, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Git

• Experience with Azure, Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, Entity Framework, Microservices, or Microsoft Entra ID is considered an advantage

• Ability to communicate effectively with developers, architects, and business stakeholders, and to balance pragmatism with engineering excellence

Who Are We?

You will be part of Business Engagement & Platform Solutions, a function of approximately 45 professionals across three business-aligned solution teams as well as architecture and integration practices.

Why should you join Orifarm?

At Orifarm, we are united by a shared purpose: improving access to affordable medicine for the people who need it. Founded in Odense in 1994 by Birgitte & Hans Bøgh-Sørensen, we have built our business on challenging conventional thinking to make affordable high-quality pharmaceuticals more accessible across Europe. Rather than developing new medicines, we focus on finding smarter ways to bring existing treatments to patients, creating value for pharmacies, healthcare systems, and society.

We live by the mindset Challenge Accepted. It reflects our explorer spirit and can-do attitude, where challenges are perceived as opportunities. We encourage people to ask questions, challenge assumptions, and take ownership. Across teams, functions, and markets, you will find a collaborative and supportive culture built on trust, respect, and a flat hierarchy where everyone has a voice and direct access to decision-makers.

When you join Orifarm, you will be empowered to make a real impact from day one. We offer autonomy and great opportunities for career advancement, enabling our employees to shape their professional development. We value flexibility and provide a hybrid work model with the possibility of working from home two days a week.

We invite you to join Orifarm, if you are curious, ambitious, and accept the challenge of bringing better deals of medicine to millions.

We encourage everyone to apply

At Orifarm, we welcome people from all backgrounds, recognizing that the best outcomes come from a diverse and inclusive work environment. Our commitment is to create an environment where different perspectives and skills drive innovation and contribute to a sustainable future. By creating such an environment, we are confident that we can achieve better results together.

jobs.occupation: Category Lead
jobs.description:
Shape the future of strategic sourcing at scale. Lead critical supplier relationships and category strategies that directly impact our ability to deliver life-saving medicines to millions of patients worldwide.

Your new role

As Category Lead in Drug Product Outsourcing, you'll be at the forefront of strategic sourcing and procurement, driving commercial excellence across complex supplier landscapes. This is a role where your decisions have real business impact – from negotiating multi-million agreements to building long-term partnerships that secure our supply chain.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Leading end-to-end category management including strategy development, market analysis, supplier negotiations, and contract finalization

• Building and maintaining strategic supplier relationships while managing risk assessment and opportunity identification across your category

• Driving commercial edge and customer-oriented behavior, utilizing market intelligence and tools to deliver significant cost savings and supply chain optimization

• Overseeing category cluster activities, coaching and mentoring team members to build capabilities and remove roadblocks

• Developing market insights and preparing strategic analysis on suppliers, spend patterns, and category trends to inform decision-making at all organizational levels

• Negotiating prices and contracts with suppliers within agreed targets, ensuring compliance with Novo Nordisk's corporate guidelines and global signing rules

• Leading cross-functional projects independently, mobilizing specialized competences across the organization to achieve optimal outcomes

Your new department

In CMC & Product Supply, we cover the full value chain from drug and device development to marketed Novo Nordisk products. We are more than 30,000 colleagues across the globe with the shared responsibility of scaling molecules, processes, devices, and products, dedicated to supplying life-saving medicines to the patients who need them most.

Within Drug Product Outsourcing, you'll join a team dedicated to securing supply availability across key sourcing categories. We act as the critical link between internal stakeholders and external suppliers, ensuring the right balance between organizational needs and optimal supply solutions. Your role will be pivotal in driving cross-functional projects that directly impact our ability to serve patients globally.

Your skills & qualifications

To succeed in this strategic role, you'll need to strike the right balance between commercial acumen and relationship building. We're looking for someone who brings:

• Minimum 10 years of experience in strategic sourcing with a proven track record, preferably within a large international company; recognized as a subject matter expert within sourcing competences

• Master's degree or MBA in management, business, or engineering (preferred)

• Exceptional ability to navigate complex and dynamic organizations, building relationships and trust while securing commitment from internal and external stakeholders

• Strong commercial mindset with the confidence to be a constructive sparring partner on key sourcing issues and challenge approaches based on solid analysis

• Proven capability to train and coach colleagues with less experience, actively supporting their development and knowledge sharing

• Ability to impact decision-making at all levels of the organization through clear recommendations based on solid analyses

• Project management expertise including the ability to plan, drive problem-solving, and prepare compelling business cases

• Personal drive and strong execution skills combined with analytical thinking and business understanding

• Excellent communication skills in both oral and written English, including professional presentation capabilities (content and presentation)

• Ability to work independently with minimal guidance while knowing when to seek advice on complex issues, and collaborative skills to work effectively across project teams

• Demonstrated ability to frequently set directions and deliver results that have significant savings and business impact

Working at Novo Nordisk

Every day we seek the solutions that defeat serious chronic diseases. To do this, we approach our work with determination, constant curiosity and a commitment to finding better ways forward. For over 100 years, this dedication has driven us to build a company focused on lasting change for long-term health. One where diverse thinking, shared purpose and mutual respect come together to create extraordinary results. Here, you'll find a culture that values your expertise and perspective, offers opportunities to grow as we transform, and empowers you to drive innovation in everything you do. When you join us, you're not just starting a job – you're becoming part of a story that spans generations.

What we offer

There is, of course, more on offer here than the uniqueness of our culture and the extraordinary results we produce. Being part of a global healthcare company means opportunities to learn and develop are all around us, while our benefits are designed with your career and life stage in mind.

Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 742,600 DKK to 1,091,600 DKK (DK), corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

Deadline

Application deadline: 25 October 2026

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

Novo Nordisk is not your typical healthcare company. In a modern world of quick fixes, we focus on solutions to defeat serious chronic diseases and promote long-term health. Our unordinary mindset is at the heart of everything we do. We seek out new ideas and put people first as we push the boundaries of science, make healthcare more accessible, and treat, prevent, and even cure diseases that affect millions of lives. Because it takes an unordinary approach to drive real, lasting change in health.

jobs.occupation: Solution Architect - Shape the architecture of tomorrow’s railway technology
jobs.description:
Do you want to turn complex business and customer needs into software solutions that actually work – technically, commercially and operationally?

Cubris is a Danish technology company and part of Hitachi Rail. From our base in Ballerup, we develop intelligent railway solutions that help operators run trains more efficiently, reliably and sustainably.

We are now strengthening Cubris’ position as a technology competence centre around our GreenSpeed® platform – and we are looking for a Solution Architect who can connect the dots between Product, customers and Engineering.

This is not an architecture role where you sit at a distance from the product. You will be involved from the early stages of an initiative: understanding the business need, challenging requirements, assessing feasibility and risks, and translating that into a solution architecture that engineering teams can implement.

What you will do

You will:

• 
Lead larger initiatives from idea and requirements through solution design

• 
Work closely with Product Managers, customers and engineering teams

• 
Translate product and customer needs into scalable and implementable solutions

• 
Design and document product architecture

• 
Clarify dependencies, feasibility and technical risks before development starts

• 
Ensure requirements are complete, consistent and technically viable

• 
Support estimation and feasibility assessments for new initiatives and customer opportunities

• 
Identify gaps between customer requirements and existing product capabilities

• 
Contribute to customer-facing discussions concerning integrations, solution design and technical capabilities

• 
Ensure that architectural decisions support cybersecurity and product requirements

The position therefore sits directly at the intersection of product strategy, requirements engineering, software architecture and delivery.

What you bring

We are looking for someone with:

• 
Strong understanding of software architecture and software development lifecycles

• 
Experience working closely with software engineering teams

• 
Experience with requirements engineering, business analysis and solution design

• 
The ability to understand complex systems and translate complexity into clear designs

• 
Strong stakeholder management, communication and facilitation skills

• 
The independence and curiosity to understand Cubris as a whole – not just one technical component

Experience from railway, transportation, safety-critical or other regulated environments is an advantage. Knowledge of V-models, quality processes and relevant EN/ISO standards is useful, but not a prerequisite.

Why Cubris?

Because this is an opportunity to influence more than individual solutions.

As Cubris develops its future engineering capability within Hitachi Rail, you will help shape both the architecture of our products and the way architecture is practised across the organisation.

You get the proximity and influence of a focused technology organisation combined with the international scale and backing of Hitachi Rail.

Location: Ballerup, Denmark
Company: Cubris – a Hitachi Rail company

Interested?

Reach out for an informal and confidential conversation.

Please note that work permit needs to be in place before applying and there is no relocation package included. You must be able to commute to the office in Ballerup every work day.

jobs.occupation: Senior Sourcing Specialist
jobs.description:
Job titleSenior Sourcing SpecialistJob description:
At BeGreen, we develop and operate renewable energy projects built to last across generations. 

We are looking for a commercially driven Senior Sourcing Specialist with a strong background in renewables to lead sourcing activities and commercial contracting across solar, hybrid, and energy storage projects based in Denmark, with exposure to international suppliers and projects. 

This position is ideal for someone who understands the unique sourcing and commercial challenges of renewable energy, whether in solar, BESS, or hybrid technologies—and who knows that the right supplier relationships and contracts are what make or break a project. Broader experience in energy infrastructure, construction, or adjacent industries is equally welcome, and will add valuable perspective to our team. 

About the role 

You will take ownership of sourcing strategies, supplier engagement, and contract execution across the full renewable energy project lifecycle. Working closely with Project Management, Engineering, Construction, Sustainability, Cyber Security, HSE, and Legal, you will ensure that commercial decisions drive project performance and long-term value. 

Your hands-on knowledge of the renewables market—its key suppliers, technology trends, cost drivers, and contractual complexities—will be a distinct advantage in this role. Whether you're navigating a large EPC tender for a solar park, structuring a BESS supply agreement, or evaluating a new contractor in an emerging market, your sector insight will be central to how you work. 

Beyond large and complex tenders, you will also support pragmatic sourcing for lower-value purchases, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and speed without compromising quality or governance. 

Key responsibilities 

• Lead end-to-end competitive tenders for major renewable energy packages, including planning, evaluation, negotiation, and contract award 
• Develop and execute sourcing strategies specifically tailored to solar parks, hybrid plants, and battery energy storage systems 
• Leverage renewables market knowledge to drive supplier assessments, benchmark pricing, and identify strategic sourcing opportunities 
• Lead commercial negotiations with energy suppliers and contractors, with a strong focus on risk management and contract robustness 
• Manage both complex, high-value sourcing processes and agile lower-value purchasing activities (RFQs, call-offs, POs) 
• Prepare decision-making materials, including total cost of ownership analyses with a clear understanding of energy project cost structures 
• Support early contract management, including supplier onboarding, performance tracking, and risk assessments 
• Contribute market intelligence on renewable energy supply chains to strengthen category strategies and long-term supplier partnerships 
What you bring 

We are looking for someone with a solid commercial background, and we particularly value: 

• Direct sourcing or commercial experience in solar, BESS, hybrid energy, wind or other renewable technologies 
• Familiarity with key renewable energy suppliers, EPC contractors, and technology providers 
• Understanding of the commercial and technical dynamics specific to utility-scale renewable projects 
 Broader energy & infrastructure experience (also highly valued): 

• Experience in conventional energy, oil & gas, transmission, or large-scale infrastructure procurement 
• Background in complex project environments with multi-stakeholder commercial interfaces 
• Exposure to long-term contracts, framework agreements, and supplier performance management 
In addition, you bring: 

• Confidence in leading negotiations and managing commercial interfaces
• A structured, proactive, and ownership-driven approach to work
• Strong stakeholder management and clear communication skills
• Knowledge of EU procurement regulations (Utilities Directive) or the motivation to build it
• Fluency in English; proficiency in Danish or Swedish is a plus
• Relocation packages are not available for this role and a valid Danish work- and residence permit is a precondition
The team you will join 

You will join BeGreen's Procurement team, a group of specialists working across category management, sourcing, and contract management. We collaborate closely, share knowledge openly, and prioritize integrity in both processes and relationships.  

 

What we offer 

• A key role in shaping sourcing practices at a fast-growing renewable energy company 
• Influence across the full project lifecycle—from early development through construction to operations 
• A collaborative, international work environment with passionate and ambitious colleagues 
• A strong focus on professional development and continuous learning 
• Office based in Carlsberg Byen, Copenhagen.  

About BeGreen 

BeGreen develops, builds, and operates onshore energy facilities – primarily solar, wind, and battery solutions. We are around 60 colleagues from diverse backgrounds. We design our projects to work in practice – technically, commercially, and in interaction with local communities. 

BeGreen is headquartered in Denmark and is part of Equinor, an international energy company. This provides a strong foundation and access to experience and competencies across markets. 

Our values: collaboration, integrity and ambition are applied to our projects, decisions, and the way we work together internally and externally.

jobs.occupation: Associate Professorship in Marketing
jobs.description:
Copenhagen Business School invites applications for a vacant Associate Professorship at the Department of Marketing. Core research areas of the Department of Marketing include Branding, B2B Marketing/Sales, Consumer Behavior, Digital Marketing, and Tourism & Hospitality Management. The associate professor’s research must have a clear relevance to one or more of the Department’s core research areas. 

Expected starting date is during 2027 (preferably no later than 1 September).

The Department is a highly regarded provider of research-based marketing education in Europe, and we consistently rank among Europe's top 5 business schools based on the number of high-quality research publications in leading marketing journals. We are committed to academic excellence and to fostering a friendly, diverse and inclusive academic environment in which colleagues engage with and support one another and contribute actively to department life. With more than 45 faculty members representing a variety of backgrounds, research interests and methodological approaches, the department offers a combination of broad and deep expertise with which we co-create and deliver value for sustainable business growth. In addition, the department engages around 60 part-time lecturers with solid, practice-oriented experience. Our teaching responsibilities comprise undergraduate, graduate, and executive teaching in general marketing and across the core research areas of the Department. Teaching is delivered in both Danish and English.

The associate professorship is a tenured position with research and teaching obligations. To fulfil the responsibilities of the position and participate actively in department life, successful applicants are expected to be physically present on a regular basis and engage in the teaching, research, and other academic activities of the Department. 

Responsibilities 

• Individual and group-based research meeting high international standards
• Contribute to the academic development of their discipline and research environment
• High-quality teaching, associated examination and educational development
• Initiating and applying for external funding 
• Contributing to the administrative responsibilities of the department and to CBS-wide tasks 
• External engagement, including generating and communicating societal impact to the public in general and to CBS’s stakeholders in particular 
• Active participation in department life, including engaging in research, supervision of early career researchers and PhD students and other academic activities, and contributing to a collaborative and supportive collegial environment
• Promoting CBS's academic reputation
Qualifications 
Candidates must demonstrate research and teaching qualifications corresponding to the level achieved through a successful Assistant Professorship or equivalent. Candidates must document relevant, original and up-to-date scientific publications at an international level within one of the core research areas covered by the department. The candidate should be able to document pedagogical qualifications, good teaching evaluations, and the ability to innovate within the educational field. CBS emphasizes the candidate’s ability to establish productive contacts with the business community and other stakeholders to provide impact. The applicant must have professional proficiency in English (written and spoken). The Department has teaching commitments in both English- and Danish-language programmes and welcomes applicants who can contribute to teaching in Danish; however, proficiency in Danish is not a requirement for the position. 

Copenhagen Business School has a broad commitment to the excellence, distinctiveness and relevance of its teaching and research. Candidates who wish to join us should demonstrate enthusiasm for working in an organization of this type (highlighting also, for example, relevant business and dissemination activities).

For further information please contact: Head of Department Thyra Uth Thomsen, tt.marktg@cbs.dk. Appointment and salary will be in accordance with the Ministry of Finance’s agreement with the Central Academic Organisation.

Application 
Applications must be sent via the electronic recruitment system, using the link above. Candidates are welcome to apply for more than one of the Department’s currently advertised positions, if relevant to their profile and career level.

Applications must include: 

• Cover letter 
• Proof of qualifications (diplomas) and a full CV including information indicating experience in industry co-operation and/or international co-operation.
• Documentation of relevant, significant, original research at an international level, including publications in the field’s internationally recognized journals and citations in the Social Science Citation Index, Scopus and/or Google Scholar. 
• A teaching portfolio documenting teaching qualifications and pedagogical development. The portfolio must include an overview of the applicant’s past teaching achievements and practice and its impact on the students, reflections on pedagogical competencies and core strengths, the educational competencies the applicant would like to develop, and the teaching opportunities they would like to pursue in the nearest future. External applicants can see the full description of the teaching portfolio here. Internal applicants must use the CBS Teaching Portfolio format. It is available at www.share.cbs.dk. Please make a pdf of each of the spreadsheets from part B of the portfolio.
• A complete, numbered list of publications (indicating titles, co-authors, page numbers and year) with an * marking the publications to be considered during the review. A maximum of 10 publications may be submitted for review. Applicants are requested to prioritise their publications in relation to the field of this job advertisement. 
• Copies of the publications marked with an *. Only publications written in English (or another specified principal language, according to research tradition) or one of the Scandinavian languages will be taken into consideration. Please include documentation and citations in the Social Science Citation Index and/or Google Scholar of any relevant, significant, original research at an international level. 
Recruitment procedure 
A minimum of two applicants will be shortlisted after the application deadline and hereafter all applicants will be notified of their status in the recruitment process. The shortlisted applicants selected for assessment will be notified about the composition of the Assessment Committee and later in the process about the result of the assessment. A selection of the qualified applicants will be invited for interviews. Once the recruitment process is completed each applicant will be notified of the outcome of their application. Copenhagen Business School must receive all application material, including all appendices (see items above), by the application deadline.

Copenhagen Business School invites all qualified candidates to apply for the position. One of CBS’ strategic goals is the promotion of diversity, which is why every effort has been made to ensure a recruitment process that reduces potential bias. Applicants are therefore encouraged not to include a photo or unnecessary personal information in their application.

Details about Copenhagen Business School and the department are available at www.cbs.dk. 

Application due 20-10-2026

Department: Quantitative Analysis Power

Employment Type: Full-Time

Start Date: As soon as possible

Magnus Jónhardsson

Magnus Jónhardsson

Lead Quantitative Analyst

mjo@nitorenergy.com

As a Quantitative Analyst at Nitor Energy, you will help advance the models, algorithms and analytical frameworks that power our trading strategies. You will work directly with complex datasets, market dynamics and production-grade code to enhance the accuracy, speed and robustness of our decision-making tools. This role offers hands-on exposure to the full lifecycle of quantitative development in a modern energy-trading company, shaping ideas, testing assumptions and turning data-driven insights into real trading impact.

The Quantitative Analyst we’re looking for is motivated, analytical and want to help elevate our data, models and workflows while accelerating their own development. You should see yourself thriving in a team that executes quickly, turning ideas into production-ready solutions with a pragmatical mindset and sense of ownership.

Your tasks will include

• Work closely with traders to develop and refine quantitative models that support profitable trading strategies

• Continuously seek improvements to workflows, analytics, risk tools, and business processes

• Conduct ad hoc quick analysis to support trading, risk, and commercial decision-making

• Design, develop, and maintain analytic and operational views used for monitoring strategies and market dynamics for trading

• Support the development and maintenance of Python-based models

• Contribute directly to advancing and scaling our data infrastructure

What we expect

• Hold a Master within a quantitative field

• You have strong quantitative, analytical, and problem-solving skills

• Have great python knowledge and an eagerness to code. Other code languages is a plus

• You must be a strong team player

• We expect you to have a pragmatic mindset and get things done

• You have a winning mentality and are willing to go the extra mile to challenge the status quo

• You have a do what it takes mentality and do not take no for an answer

What we offer

• A young, dynamic, ambitious and fun work environment

• Extensive opportunities for personal development and career growth. You will be given responsibility from day one and receive close sparring with experienced colleagues

Nitor Energy is a fast-growing energy trading company, that has swiftly transitioned from start-up to scale-up within just a few years. Our employees thrive on challenges and are motivated by the potential that lies ahead.

Our unique culture integrates traders, coders, and analysts into cohesive teams, creating a well-rounded approach to our success. We believe in a balanced work-life dynamic and foster a vibrant, engaging atmosphere where our employees can excel in every aspect.

Lead Quantitative Analyst

jobs.occupation: Experienced Electronics Engineer for Manufacturing Engineering
jobs.description:
Are you looking for an engineering role where you help turn advanced sports technology into scalable, high-quality products? At Trackman, you will play a key role in industrializing, testing, and producing innovative hardware solutions bridging R&D and production with real technical influence and cross-functional impact.

Your Role

As an experienced Engineer in “Manufacturing Engineering” which is a part of the “Hardware Development & Supply” organization, you will act as a key technical contributor across R&D and Production. Your responsibilities will be to ensure that Trackman’s new and existing hardware platforms can be produced reliably, at scale and volume.

You will be expected to ensure design for manufacturing (DFM).  This involves challenge designs, propose improvements, and drive best practices across the organization in close collaboration with R&D hardware, tracking and software teams, in-house production, EMS suppliers, supply chain, and management.

This role suits an experienced engineer who enjoys combining hands-on engineering with technical expertise and ownership.

What you will be doing

• 
Specifying, developing, and driving a strategy for production- and test engineering equipment to support new and existing hardware platforms. We work with GHZ Radars, Computer Modules, Camera Sensors and other state of the art electronics.

• 
Act as an experienced technical interface between R&D and Production, ensuring manufacturability and testability are built in from early design phases.

• 
Design, build and validate production- and test solutions for all relevant technologies. This includes fixtures for assemblies, automation, “bed of nails” setups, and other supporting electronics.

• 
Develop automated test solutions using NI TestStand, Python, and C#, including data handling, traceability, and statistical analysis.

• 
Perform hands-on debugging utilizing signal generators, spectrum analyzers, oscilloscopes ect. for root-cause analysis.

• 
Participate in schematic entry, reviews, placement and carry out layout and routing of simple PCBs used in test fixtures and support electronics

• 
Drive collaboration with EMS suppliers, including transfer, ramp-up, and continuous improvement of test and production processes

• 
Analyze production and test data to improve yield, quality, and robustness, and to support data-driven decision-making

• 
Strengthen the ability to plan and execute according to plan, i.e. spending part of your time doing project coordination work supporting the whole team.

Job requirements

What You Bring

We imagine that you:

• 
Hold a degree in Electronics Engineering and have extensive experience (5+ years) within electronics development, production, or test engineering

• 
Have strong practical experience with test development, electronics debugging, and production environments

• 
Advanced user of relevant lab test equipment (e.g., oscilloscope, signal generators, spectrum analyzers etc.)

• 
Are comfortable taking technical ownership and influencing decisions across teams and senior stakeholders

• 
Work in a structured, proactive way and naturally drive improvements

• 
Fluent in Danish and English, written and spoken and located in Denmark

Technical skills:

• 
Advanced experience with Python, NI TestStand, C# and data analysis.

• 
Experience with RF measurements in the GHz range and understanding of schematics.

• 
Experience in implementing test equipment at EMS suppliers, transferring test data between different sites

• 
Knowledge of camera and optics calibration principles.

The Office

We are located in our state-of-art HQ in Hørsholm, located at DTU Science Park. We take great pride in the building we designed! The office features bright meeting rooms, coffee areas to catch up with colleagues, a large testing arena with simulators available for employees and a fitness centre, everything surrounded by a beautiful forest and respecting the environment. We made sure to utilize the newest technologies to be energy efficient and be mindful of ventilation and sound propagation. The cherry on top is our canteen: with an indoor and outdoor area to enjoy the fresh food prepared by our own kitchen staff.

Join the home of a powerful sports brand and a one-of-a-kind technology

Our proprietary technology is based on expert knowledge about radar, computer vision, data, and software engineering. Our solutions are developed by specialists who endlessly explore and challenge new technical boundaries. Trackman’s blend of cutting-edge technology, sports, and continued growth make our company an outstanding place to work.

Our work culture is entrepreneurial, ambitious, and rewarding as you get to collaborate with inspiring colleagues and interact with the leaders of golf, baseball, and football. Based on a unique brand reputation, we are proud to work in close partnership with the top athletes, organizations, and teams that rely on our technology to stay ahead of the race.

We are a Danish company founded, owned, and managed since 2003 by three entrepreneurs with a strong passion for sports. Today, we have a global footprint with our headquarters located in Denmark (Hørsholm) and offices in New York, Phoenix, Seoul and Tokyo. We employ over 1000+ people worldwide, half of which work in Denmark, where most hardware and software products are developed, tested, and manufactured.

Where innovation happens

At Trackman, we know that great people make great products. We believe that teams thrive, and innovation sparks in an atmosphere where people are encouraged to think for themselves, where everybody’s voices are heard, and where the best ideas prevail in the pursuit of exceptional solutions. This mix makes Trackman an inspiring company – for our customers and colleagues.

Share our Passion!

Applications are continuously assessed, so please send your application as soon as possible. We look forward to hearing from you.
